name: storycrest
description: Design a personalized picture book with your child as the hero, preview the real cover, and order it as a printed hardcover from storycrestbooks.com.

interface.longDescription:
Turn your child into the hero of their own printed picture book.

Tell ChatGPT your child's first name, what they love and any occasion. Build their character right in the chat (skin colour, hair, glasses, freckles), pick an art style, and StoryCrest draws the real cover and writes the story outline so you can see exactly what you are getting. Ask for changes in plain words and get a new cover.

When you are happy, order the finished book as an 8.5" × 8.5" hardcover on storycrestbooks.com. After you order, every page is illustrated with your character in the style you chose, then the book is printed and shipped to you, in most countries worldwide.

StoryCrest is for parents, guardians and gift-givers. No photos or birthdays are needed: just a first name and a few drawing choices.
capabilities: Preview the real cover and story outline
Order a printed hardcover on storycrestbooks.com
defaultPrompt: Make a personalized storybook for my daughter's 5th birthday
Create a bedtime picture book starring my son, who loves space
Design a keepsake picture book with my child as the hero

positive.description: Collect the details in the conversation and show the styles
positive.prompt: Make a personalized storybook for my daughter Maya's 5th birthday. She loves dinosaurs and painting.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks any missing details in the chat (no form, no photo, no birthday) and shows the inline style card with story worlds and art-style pictures. Tapping a look sends the choice as a chat message.

positive.description: Build the child's character and create the cover and story outline
positive.prompt: Let's use Watercolor and Outer Space for Leo's book. He loves rockets.
positive.expected_behavior: An inline cover card shows Leo's book and a character builder (skin colour, hair colour, hairstyle, glasses, freckles) with a painted preview. After the reviewer builds the character and presses 'Draw the cover', the card shows progress and, usually within about a minute, the drawn cover with that character, the title, a synopsis and the order button. No photo is asked for.

positive.description: Ask for a change in the chat
positive.prompt: Can you make Leo's book more magical and try a different art style?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls create_book_cover again with the updated details. A new cover card appears; the reviewer builds or keeps the character and draws a new cover and outline.

positive.description: Order the printed hardcover on storycrestbooks.com
positive.prompt: This looks great. How do I order the printed book?
positive.expected_behavior: The card's 'Order the printed book · $49.99 + shipping' button opens storycrestbooks.com/chatgpt/order in the browser, showing the approved cover, what is included, ship-to country, email and the book + shipping total. Pressing 'Order printed book' shows the payment form; reviewers can stop there, as no purchase is needed to test the plugin. The demo video shows a complete order.

positive.description: Open the full studio on request
positive.prompt: Open the StoryCrest studio so I can fill everything in myself.
positive.expected_behavior: An inline card opens the full-screen StoryCrest studio (details, character builder, style, cover). Price and shipping questions are answered in the chat: a printed 8.5" × 8.5" hardcover for $49.99 plus shipping, delivered to most countries worldwide.

negative.description: Digital-only request: no tool is called; ChatGPT explains that only the printed hardcover ($49.99 plus shipping) is sold and no PDF, download or other digital version is offered
negative.prompt: Can I just buy a PDF of the book to download instead of the printed copy?

negative.description: Unsupported destination: no book is started and no card is shown; ChatGPT explains StoryCrest can't ship printed books to Brazil yet (one of the few countries it can't deliver to) and offers to make the book if it can ship somewhere else
negative.prompt: Make a book for my son and ship it to Brazil.

negative.description: A child asking for themselves: no tool is called and nothing personal is requested; ChatGPT replies that a parent or guardian needs to make the book with them
negative.prompt: I'm 9 years old. Can you make a book about me with my photo?

review.commerce_description: StoryCrest sells one physical product: a personalized printed hardcover picture book ($49.99 plus shipping, delivered to most countries worldwide). Checkout happens on our own domain (storycrestbooks.com/chatgpt/order) through our payment provider, Whop. Designing the book and previewing the cover and outline in ChatGPT is free. Orders that start in ChatGPT buy only the printed book: no digital downloads, subscriptions, credits or other digital goods are offered or delivered.

publication.release_notes: No photos or birthdays any more: build your child's character right in the chat (skin colour, hair, glasses, freckles) with a painted preview, then StoryCrest draws the real cover and story outline with that character. Only the child's first name and interests are asked for.
